title: The Fletching Table Addon - More Fletching recipes
description: This is an addon datapack for "The Fletching Table" adding a recipe for more arrows and a few situational items.
body:
This simple datapack adds recipes for 16x Arrows, bundles and supplementaries quivers to The Fletching Table by kwahson

## Recipes:

16 Arrows (same ratio as runes on the rune crafting table for spell engine):
